newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market down, recovery seen ahead.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market down, recovery seen ahead.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market drifted lower on Thursday as some heavyweights posted weaker quotes, traders said.
Independent indices VAB-RASDAQ and BIG-OTC, computed by the VANGUARD and BIG brokerage houses, slipped by 0.78 and 1.36 percent respectively to 3,621.35 and 2,685.97 points.
Gains were registered by 105 stocks, with 86 slipping and 291 unchanged.
"There were quite a few gains, but unfortunately the stocks that went up have less effect on the market," a trader said.
With most quotes flat, operators expected a stabilisation of the market, with possibly a slight rise on Friday.
Cement maker Moldocim -- a market attraction -- ended unchanged at 30,500 lei, while another cement maker, Romcim, gained 500 lei to close at 65,500.
Operators said they expected Romcim to extend gains on news that big foreign investors planned to buy large stakes in the company.
Arpechim registered the biggest gains among popular oil refineries, moving ahead 1,500 lei to 26,500.
Thursday's turnover fell to 8.97 billion lei from 10.32 billion previously, with volumes sliding to 3.25 million shares from 4.08 million. ($=7,084 lei)
